test_to_timedelta_string_parsing: test pd.to_timedelta parsing mixed unit strings like '1 days 06:05:01.00003' and '15.5us'
test_to_timedelta_nat_handling: test pd.to_timedelta handling of None, np.nan, pd.NaT, and pd.NA returning NaT values
test_to_timedelta_overflow_errors: test pd.to_timedelta raising OutOfBoundsTimedelta for values exceeding int64 bounds at various units
test_to_timedelta_unit_conversion: test pd.to_timedelta converting numeric arrays with explicit unit parameter like 'ns', 's', 'D'
test_to_timedelta_coerce_errors: test pd.to_timedelta with errors='coerce' converting unparseable strings to NaT instead of raising
test_timedelta_index_creation: test TimedeltaIndex construction from lists of strings, integers, and timedelta64 arrays
test_pd_timedelta_scalar: test pd.Timedelta scalar construction from strings, integers with units, and datetime64 views
test_timedelta_array_from_sequence: test TimedeltaArray._from_sequence constructing from numpy timedelta arrays with dtype conversion
test_to_timedelta_mixed_dtypes: test pd.to_timedelta handling mixed dtype inputs including int64, timedelta64, and nullable Int64
test_to_timedelta_precision: test pd.to_timedelta and pd.Timedelta precision handling for sub-nanosecond string values
